title: The Pólya–Vinogradov inequality with log log q for all but q^ε characters: paper, Lean 4 library and checking programs
description:
Final revision of the paper, single column, 26 pages, with its LaTeX source, programs that check the explicit constants of the proofs and compute the character sums for small moduli, and a Lean 4 library. For every ε > 0 there is C_ε such that, for every modulus q ≥ 3, at most q^ε of the primitive characters χ modulo q have M(χ) > C_ε √q log log q, where M(χ) is the largest modulus of a partial sum of χ, and at most q^ε of the nonprincipal characters have |L'/L(1, χ)| > C_ε log log q. The proof is a transfer theorem for a single character, proved by a contour shift, the circle method and a weak Montgomery–Vaughan bound from Selberg's sieve, and a count of the exceptional characters by a zero-density theorem proved in full in Appendix A with explicit constants. Every statement is proved by hand from Chebyshev's bounds, except the bound for every character (Theorem 1.5), which rests on the zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 of OpenAI's preprint The quasi-Riemann hypothesis (30 September 2026); that Lean 4 proof is compiled from source and checked by the Lean kernel in this repository, together with a Lean proof of Theorem 1.5 from it.

The results were first made public on 15 October 2026 as release v1.0.0 of this repository (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23383715). An earlier and incomplete version of the paper appeared on Hexagon as hexagon:2610.00256.
